'''DecipherCon 1999''' (DecipherCon '99) was Decipher's first company convention, held 11–14 November 1999 at the Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia. It hosted the [[1999 Decipher World Championship|Star Wars CCG World Championship]], in which [[Gary Carman]] defeated [[Steven Lewis]] 2 (+19).<ref name="idx">[https://web.archive.org/web/19991128065643/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/index.html DecipherCon], Decipher (Wayback 28 November 1999)</ref><ref name="sw">[https://web.archive.org/web/19991128144348/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/swworldchamp/index.html Star Wars CCG World Championship], Decipher (Wayback 28 November 1999)</ref>

== Venue and dates ==

* '''Dates:''' 11–14 November 1999 (Thursday–Sunday)
* '''Site:''' Cavalier Hotel / Cavalier Hotel at the Oceanfront, Virginia Beach, Virginia

Worlds Day 1 was Friday 12 November. Day 2 and the Final Confrontation were Saturday 13 November. Thursday 11 November held the Wild Card: 146 Star Wars players, with the top two ([[John Arendt]] and James Lafferty) taking seats into Friday's field of 32.<ref name="thu">[https://web.archive.org/web/20000903021929/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/thursday.html Lalumiere Thursday], DecipherCon '99 (Wayback)</ref><ref name="field">[https://web.archive.org/web/19991128125001/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/swworldchamp/finalists.html Finalists], Decipher (Wayback 28 November 1999)</ref>

== Guests ==

Special guests were Chase Masterson (Leeta), [[Shannon Baksa]] (Mara Jade), Aron Eisenberg (Nog), and Jeremy Bulloch (Boba Fett). Baksa signed Friday 1–3pm and Saturday/Sunday 12–2pm and appeared as Mara Jade in costume.<ref name="guests">[https://web.archive.org/web/20000122135443/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/specialguests/index.html Special guests], DecipherCon '99 (Wayback)</ref><ref name="sat">[https://web.archive.org/web/20001120012500/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/saturday.html Lalumiere Saturday], DecipherCon '99 (Wayback)</ref>

== Star Wars CCG World Championship ==

Full results and lists are on [[1999 Decipher World Championship]]. The constructed pool was [[Premiere - Endor]]. The field of 32 was 4 Open + 2 Invitational + 23 Regional + 2 Wild Card + 1 defending champion ([[Matt Potter]]).<ref name="field" />

[[Joe Alread]] won Iron Man on Friday and missed the main event for the first time.<ref name="fri">[https://web.archive.org/web/20001120001100/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/friday.html Lalumiere Friday], DecipherCon '99 (Wayback)</ref>

Lalumiere's Saturday wrap also recorded an ECC sealed of 176 players — "biggest tournament in Star Wars CCG history" on that report, beating Origins constructed 152 — plus Young Jedi champion Greg Heisler and Star Trek champion Mike Harrington.<ref name="sat" />
